head: 38da6a388a37a9dce4026fea662a60c84e347dc2
decision: Approve the nonlinear test correction to unblock #207.
before: The old test failed on JAX 0.12.1 even though both solvers reached the same root.
after: The revised tests check the forcing rule directly. On three shifted Laplacians, adaptive GMRES took 28–29 iterations versus 84–87 at fixed tolerance. All 36 local nonlinear tests and required CI jobs passed.

head: 47c6b84b1cba0363a5fa3294e8a903faeefeea38
decision: Move the guiding-centre energy fix out of draft for review.
before: In the adaptive coil test with an electric potential, relative total-energy drift was 9.9e-4.
after: The reported drift fell to 4.4e-10 by retaining the launch magnetic moment. Three local checks passed. Review the five-component state for electric-field callers.

head: 179a951fe8b7620e8b800a021a38a9b7a3c5c803
decision: Approve the warm-cache gradient fix. CI passed.
before: A warm disk cache caused a gradient test to fail on main.
after: The reported warm-cache pair now passes both tests. An independent local run passed the loaded-executable derivative test.

head: d6f80192a0ae8ef37c127c4b5733a90c130c4f52
decision: Move the near-axis Boozer correction out of draft for review.
before: On the first half surface of the Solov’ev case, the relative error in the Z harmonic was 0.50 against booz_xform.
after: Extrapolating the m = 1 terms reduced the reported error to 6.4e-16. Four local Boozer reference and interpolation tests passed.

head: a57c05c4c381b93c9e96a3b7cd7ce9aef37b5247
before: The unequal-temperature case gave densities of 1.32 and 0.0000138 for species initialized at unit density.
after: Both recover unit density. The longitudinal field satisfies Gauss’s law. All 29 local tests passed.

head: 7b746917bd4e363b5200a0989be0a0002f8c5164
decision: Merge the local FCI operator tests.
before: The shard-local operator module had 11% coverage.
after: Eight tests raise coverage to 37% and check the discrete flux balance to 1e-12.

head: 057dfb0e35b41e7771d8cfcaf611fa92ab4e4469
decision: Approve the Redl comparison after CI passes.
before: At the example’s original shaping, the tokamak formula and DKX predicted opposite signs.
after: At weak shaping and zero radial electric field, both predict positive current on both surfaces. The example now labels the formula’s range of validity.

head: 1e5c39069fc0c854b98370eaceb4abfb302fbab2
decision: Approve the per-surface solver diagnostics after CI passes.
before: The output gave the same reason for every solve route.
after: Tutorial 05 now shows why both surfaces switched to Krylov. The direct-solve residuals were 0.0066 and 0.15.

head: 47e2877fbcbb3e037944cedc4f0428e7f9e9b5e1
before: Main rejected a profile and three scan points at tolerance 1e-18.
after: All four pass. The transport moments match the 1e-10 reference bit for bit.

head: 90caba761b4e41eda912f733f96f17a0aa6cc04d
decision: Resolve the JAX 0.12.1 CI failure and obtain independent approval.
before: A 1,000-block adjoint took 25.21 ms on the M4.
after: The median fell to 17.48 ms. Paired application runs found no repeatable gain for VMEX or virtual casing.
validation: On JAX 0.12.1 the nonlinear test used 1,127 adaptive versus 1,119 fixed Krylov iterations on both main and this PR. Both revisions passed on JAX 0.12.0.1.

head: 4085ce8495c88c6cd50709f34fb16d3732a16c22
decision: Eduardo has been asked to review particle-loss reporting.
before: A stop or numerical failure could count as particle loss.
after: The corrected result distinguishes a physical loss, a requested stop and a numerical failure.

head: fc0e54d1c3da4e93d1108e0d7f31d5152513cce4
decision: Choose one implementation of lower-memory factors with #459.
before: Both PRs change storage in the same coarse preconditioner.
after: This branch solved the large W7-X case, but peak memory exceeded its estimate. Preserve both forward and transpose checks when combining the changes.

head: 31e961c7a5dfd88ba1e858d4bbd907875b20500e
decision: Review anchor-factor reuse after refreshing the branch.
before: The benchmark rebuilt the preconditioner 30 times per free-boundary run.
after: Three builds reached the same final objective. The reported median warm wall time fell from 327.7 to 311.8 seconds.

head: 4e29a44391236822b82e80f529d800d4b17f202d
decision: Review the collision change on its parent branch.
before: On four Xeon cores, 200 steps with 45,000 particles took 9.36 s warm.
after: The median fell to 4.30 s. Four seeds retained Gauss residuals below 8 × 10⁻¹⁵.

head: 9b970ccc46323180d9580b7a34b3dae01c4dca70
before: On four Xeon cores, the third heated RK3 chunk took 10.39 s and recompiled.
after: The third chunk took 2.11 s. Its output fields matched bit for bit.

head: 9364a29a45ab574beb80fccc87efff85914b9d32
decision: Use this preconditioner for long runs after checking setup cost.
before: The warm four-field test took 0.349 s per step. The full short case took 37.64 s.
after: Warm time fell to 0.108 s but the whole case took 38.27 s. The larger setup cost needs a longer run to pay back.

head: 2de4200320bc8945b7d0d0feb196ae138ca04687
decision: Review real transforms for the reduced-MHD path.
before: The 128² Orszag–Tang case took 1.706 s warm for 400 steps on the M4.
after: The same 400 steps took 1.183 s. The physics checks passed.

head: 3f2fe7d73ce9a52f1ddca90dbe1cba6e7d4ff30b
decision: Review the GPU scatter change against its feature-branch parent.
before: On a shared A4000 the 262,144-particle trajectory took 2.069 s warm. Peak device allocation was 166 MiB.
after: The same trajectory took 0.778 s warm with electric-field histories matching within 6 × 10⁻¹³ relative. Peak allocation grew to 190 MiB.
